name: HeyGen Video Virality Rework Agent
purpose: Watch a Google Drive folder for manually uploaded HeyGen videos, ask Gemini for a viral audit and FFmpeg edit plan, render a stronger version with free FFmpeg, and upload the result back to Drive.

nodes.name: Watch Uploaded HeyGen Videos
nodes.description: Triggers when a new manually rendered HeyGen video appears in the input folder.

nodes.name: Download HeyGen Video
nodes.description: Downloads the new video as binary data.

nodes.name: Upload Video to Gemini File API
nodes.description: Uploads video to Gemini so the model can inspect audio and visuals.

nodes.name: Generate Virality Audit
nodes.description: Uses Gemini video understanding and prompts/virality-audit-prompt.md.

nodes.name: Generate FFmpeg Edit Plan
nodes.description: Turns feedback into exact caption overlays, hook text, CTA text, and filename.

nodes.name: Save Audit to Drive
nodes.description: Uploads the audit/edit plan JSON to the audit folder.

nodes.name: Render Improved Video
nodes.description: Runs npm run improve-video with FFmpeg if the n8n host supports local command execution.

nodes.name: Upload Improved Video to Drive
nodes.description: Uploads the improved MP4 to the reworked folder.
